# GLO Aesthetics + Wellness Lounge

> Medical spa in Ocala and Palatka, Florida offering injectables (Xeomin, Daxxify, dermal filler), laser and radiofrequency skin treatments (Tetra CO2, Motus, Everesse), facials, chemical peels, microneedling, laser hair removal and medical wellness (hormone replacement, peptide therapy, medical weight loss, IV hydration). Treatments are performed by licensed providers under the direction of a Florida-licensed Medical Director.
